public-url.title: Public address
public-url.description: The address people use to reach BoardGameTracker, for example https://games.example.com. Invitation and password-reset emails link to it, and SSO uses it for its redirect URIs. Emails with links are only sent once it is set.
public-url.label: Public URL
public-url.not-set: Not set. Invitation and password-reset emails are not sent, and SSO uses the address you open the app on.
public-url.insecure-warning: The public URL uses http while BoardGameTracker is opened over https. Links in emails, RSVP invitations and SSO redirects will use the insecure address.
public-url.host-mismatch-warning: The public URL points to a different host than {{host}}. Links in emails, RSVP invitations and SSO redirects will use that host.

confirm.title: Reset data
confirm.description: This permanently deletes all games, sessions, players, people, locations, loans, game nights, badge awards, and uploaded images. Your settings, user accounts, and login are kept. This cannot be undone.

confirm.title: Factory reset
confirm.description: This permanently deletes EVERYTHING — all data, all settings, and all user accounts — and resets the app to its initial state. The admin account is recreated with the password from ADMIN_PASSWORD, or admin when that is not set, and you will be logged out. Change that password immediately. This cannot be undone.

sso.title: OpenID Connect provider

description.empty: Let people sign in through your identity provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia, Zitadel, Entra ID, …). Register a public client there first, then fill in the details below.
description.configured: Sign-in through {{name}} is configured. Changes apply to the next sign-in.

sso.https-required: Single sign-on requires HTTPS. Put BoardGameTracker behind a reverse proxy with TLS and set an https public URL.

name.label: Short name
name.rename-warning: Changing the short name changes the redirect URIs below. Register the new ones at your provider; linked accounts keep working.

authority.label: Authority (issuer URL)
authority.relink-warning: Changing the address unlinks every account linked to this provider. Users then sign in with their password and link it again from their profile; users without a password need one first.

client-secret.label: Client secret (optional)
client-secret.placeholder: Leave empty for a public client
client-secret.unchanged: Stored — leave empty to keep it

auto-provision.label: Create accounts on first sign-in
auto-provision.description: New people get an account with the default role automatically. When off, only linked accounts can sign in.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the sign-in button on the login page.
enabled.https-required: Single sign-on can only be turned on over HTTPS.

fields.role-sync: With a groups claim and admin group set, accounts created through the provider get Admin when they are in that group and the default role otherwise, on every sign-in. The last admin is never demoted.

discovery.ok: The provider answered and its issuer matches the authority.
discovery.issuer-mismatch: The provider answered, but reports issuer {{issuer}}. Use that value as the authority.
discovery.failed: The provider could not be reached or did not return a discovery document.

setup.title: Register at the provider
setup.description: Allow these redirect URIs on the client you created at your identity provider.
setup.public-url-warning: No public URL is configured, so the redirect URIs are derived from the current request ({{url}}). Set the public URL under General if that is not the address people use.

validation.name: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (1–100 characters)
validation.scopes: At least the openid scope is required

sso.delete-description: Removing the provider also removes every linked external account. People keep their local password if they have one.

notifications.save-failed: The provider could not be saved.
notifications.delete-failed: The provider could not be removed.
